blocks.text: NEW ORLEANS — The New Orleans Pelicans have exercised a fourth-year option on third-year center Yves Missi, as well as third-year options on both of their 2025 first-round draft picks: guard Jeremiah Fears and forward Derik Queen. The moves, announced Tuesday, were expected as Missi is the club’s projected starting center this season, while both Fears and Queen produced while receiving ample playing time as rookies in the team’s first season with Joe Dumars serving as executive vice president of basketball operations.
